snippet.title: KALANORO - REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Kalanoro is a joyful action-adventure inspired by Malagasy folklore, made with ❤️ & ☕ 
Play as Kalakely, build a band of legendary lemur musicians 🐒, and take on the evil witch Raneny in a vibrant musical roadtrip.
Dash, fight with chaotic weapons, and keep your crew rolling in your trusty taxi-brousse.

Coming to Xbox Series X|S, PC, Playstation 5 & Switch in Summer 2026 🎤✨

🎮 *Play the Demo!*

On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4271600/Kalanoro_Demo/

✨ *Wishlist Kalanoro Now!*

Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/kalanoro/9PH0FQN366M7/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158820/Kalanoro/

PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018391/
